steps.content: Under the leadership of the MBCC's Chief, the medical team quickly arrived to support the Eastian delegation. The sorcery was temporarily lifted and the Sun Crow's power got stronger, but according to news from the FAC's DisSea frontline, losses have been within the manageable range so far.

The FAC seems to have given up on confronting the Sun Crow head-on and switched to a more roundabout tactic to wear it down. They seem to be trying to conserve resources, or waiting for some kind of turning point.

steps.speaker: Du Ruo
steps.content: The FAC's strategy has changed. This isn't something that little triangle would order...

steps.speaker: Du Ruo
steps.content: Dear Chief, what have you done?

steps.speaker: FAC Officer
steps.content: Are you serious? Are you sure now is the best time to...

February 6, N.F. 114.
Time left until the second Apostle interception:
Four hours and twenty minutes.
Under the scorching sun, the troops are only a dozen kilometers away from the Apostle. Upon hearing your plan, all the soldiers' expressions turn heavy.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: The Almighty Bow produced by the Eastians has been rendered useless. But I and a few FAC soldiers watched and assisted with the entire crafting process.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I want to make another bow with the same effect as soon as possible, and for that I require your assistance. This should not take up much manpower from the main battlefield.

steps.speaker: FAC Officer
steps.content: ...Eastia's plan has already failed. They are also suspected of espionage, threatening the city's security, and other crimes. We can't trust any documents they've left behind.

options: You don't have to believe me.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Just believe in yourselves.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: All I'm doing is offering you guys a little help.
You present a brand-new report.

steps.speaker: FAC Officer
steps.content: That's...!

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: A summary of the MBCC's reports on the bow-crafting mission, an analysis of the materials by the Ring Research Institute, and the decoded texts of the documents left by the Eastian scholar Du Ruo.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: We don't have to blindly believe in that myth. But note that DisCity has its own history, scholars, and heroes too.
You turn to the FAC troops, who have been through countless battles. Battles with the Black Rings, with the disasters, and with their own weakness and fear.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: We've all experienced those unusual phenomena in the Black Rings together. The myth may sound far-fetched, but we can't deny the things that have actually happened.

If you need evidence, the Ring Research Institute has preliminarily confirmed that the principle behind the power of the bow and the birth of the Apostle of Ashes is the same. In both cases, the power originates from the collective will.
And be confident about one thing: The destruction of the three Black Rings and the century-long peace in DisCity have all been a result of your hard work and courage.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I believe such willpower exists in DisCity too.

steps.speaker: FAC Officer
steps.content: ...I see. If that's what you advise, Chief.

steps.speaker: Du Ruo
steps.content: Oh... So the honorable Chief went to my room and peeked at my files...

options: It's all to defeat the Apostle.
The Institute gave them to you anyway.

steps.speaker: Du Ruo
steps.content: Haha, just kidding. I'm glad those messy notes could be of help.

steps.speaker: Du Ruo
steps.content: Your argument is very persuasive. You're an expert in combating the Black Rings, after all.

options: Some of it was made up, though.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: The 9th Agency has a few contacts in the Ring Research Institute. They got me some help.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: But that wasn't enough to convince the Paradeisos. I had to add, "These are the Eastian secrets I've painstakingly decoded." Those old men in Paradeisos were tempted right away.

steps.speaker: Du Ruo
steps.content: ...You've gotten a lot better at lying. You've fooled even me.
A smile shows on her face.

steps.speaker: FAC Officer
steps.content: The special squad will split into two groups to head to the ruins of BR-002 and BR-001. Your goal is clear: Find and prepare the materials as fast as you can and bring them back to Chief ${PlayerName}.

steps.speaker: FAC Officer
steps.content: Everyone else, head to the DisSea and intercept the Apostle of Ashes. The goal is to hold it off and buy time for Chief.

steps.speaker: FAC Officer
steps.content: I have no more lectures to give. He's defeated all three problematic Black Rings with the FAC. He has always stood with us and fought with his life next to us. He has the FAC's trust.
steps.female_content: I have no more lectures to give. She's defeated all three problematic Black Rings with the FAC. She has always stood with us and fought with her life next to us. She has the FAC's trust.

steps.speaker: FAC Officer
steps.content: Haha, let's look forward to what new possibilities he will bring us again. It's not the first time, after all.
steps.female_content: Haha, let's look forward to what new possibilities she will bring us again. It's not the first time, after all.

steps.speaker: FAC Officer
steps.content: Now, move out!
